description: Structured educational reference data for PEMF contraindication and caution categories, beginner safety framing, and related Holistix PEMF resources.
medical_disclaimer: This dataset is for educational and informational purposes only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, cure, prevention, or a substitute for professional healthcare guidance. Anyone who is pregnant, has an implanted medical device, has a serious health condition, takes prescription medication, or is unsure whether PEMF is appropriate should consult a qualified healthcare professional before use.

records.plain_language_summary: People with pacemakers, implanted defibrillators, neurostimulators, insulin pumps, or other implanted electronic medical devices should avoid PEMF unless cleared by a qualified clinician.
records.educational_notes: PEMF devices use electromagnetic fields. Implanted electronic devices may be sensitive to electromagnetic interference. This is a conservative safety category, not personalized medical advice.

records.plain_language_summary: People who are pregnant or may be pregnant should consult a qualified healthcare professional before using PEMF devices.
records.educational_notes: Pregnancy is commonly treated as a conservative-use category for many wellness technologies. This dataset does not provide pregnancy-specific medical guidance.

records.plain_language_summary: People with epilepsy or a seizure history should ask a qualified healthcare professional before using PEMF devices.
records.educational_notes: Individual sensitivity can vary. Conservative screening is recommended for people with neurological conditions or seizure history.

records.contraindication_or_caution: Active cancer or serious medical condition
records.plain_language_summary: People with active cancer, serious illness, or complex medical conditions should consult a qualified healthcare professional before PEMF use.
records.educational_notes: PEMF should not be used as a substitute for medical care or as a disease treatment claim.

records.plain_language_summary: People recovering from surgery, acute injury, bleeding, or unstable medical conditions should ask a healthcare professional before PEMF use.
records.educational_notes: Timing, placement, and medical status matter. This is a caution category for conservative wellness-device use.

records.contraindication_or_caution: Blood clot risk or implanted metal hardware
records.plain_language_summary: People with clotting concerns, implanted hardware, or post-surgical implants should consult a qualified healthcare professional before PEMF use.
records.educational_notes: Not all metal implants are electronic, but medical context matters. Professional guidance is recommended for complex cases.

records.plain_language_summary: People using prescription medications should ask a qualified healthcare professional if they are unsure whether PEMF is appropriate.
records.educational_notes: Medication status can indicate underlying health conditions. This is a conservative screening note, not a direct contraindication for all users.

records.plain_language_summary: PEMF use for children or minors should be guided by a qualified healthcare professional and parent or guardian.
records.educational_notes: This dataset is designed for adult consumer wellness education and does not provide pediatric guidance.

records.plain_language_summary: People with reduced sensation, heat sensitivity, or skin sensitivity should use caution with PEMF mats that include heat or prolonged contact.
records.educational_notes: Some PEMF mats may include heat or extended body contact. Comfort, skin response, and sensation should be monitored.

records.plain_language_summary: Beginners should avoid long, aggressive, or high-intensity sessions when starting PEMF.
records.educational_notes: Start conservatively, follow device instructions, and adjust gradually based on comfort. More is not automatically better.
